arrangement.notes: Arrangement follows a cinematic rise and fall energy profile, emphasizing an experimental take on West Coast Hip-Hop with dark mood. Sample layers use micro chops, phrase chops, reverse chops, vocal chops, and stutter chops, with channel names reflecting chopping techniques.

event_markers.label: Hook Start
event_markers.reason: Elevated energy and vocal chops with reverse samples

event_markers.label: Bridge Start
event_markers.reason: Experimental soundscape and stutter chops increase

event_markers.label: Final Hook Start
event_markers.reason: High intensity vocal chops and phrase chops dominate

event_markers.label: Outro Start
event_markers.reason: Energy wind down with micro chops and reverse chops fade

micro_chops.description: Sample slices shortened to micro segments used across drums and fx

phrase_chops.description: Longer sample phrase slices mainly used in vocal and melody lanes

reverse_chops.description: Samples reversed for FX and vocal manipulation

vocal_chops.description: Chopped vocal snippets processed for rhythmic stutter and pitch variation

stutter_chops.description: Repeated short chops used to create stutter effects

sound_intent.energy_profile: smooth rise and fall creating dynamic tension
sound_intent.sample_manipulation: intricate sample chops providing rhythmic and melodic complexity

routing_intent.drums: send to micro_chops channel with parallel compression
routing_intent.bass: filtered and compressed with subtle use of phrase chops
routing_intent.chords: processed with reverb and delay utilising reverse chops
routing_intent.melody: clean phrase chops with modulation effects
routing_intent.vocal: heavy vocal chops with delays and stutters routed dynamically
routing_intent.fx: reverse and stutter chops emphasized with wide stereo imaging

track_roles.bass: low end support with phrase chops
track_roles.vocal: vocal textures and hooks with chopped samples
track_roles.fx: ambient and transitional effects with reverse and stutter chops

designer_intent.focus: Create a dark, atmospheric West Coast Hip-Hop piece with experimental sample chops and dynamic energy flow.

presetor_intent.goal: Implement sound presets that highlight the unique chopping techniques and cinematic energy profile.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate rhythmic patterns emphasizing micro chops with dynamic variation across sections.

bass_generator.brief: Produce bass lines that complement phrase chops, matching the dark mood and cinematic energy.

harmony_generator.brief: Create harmonic chord textures using reverse chops and reverb effects to add depth.

melody_generator.brief: Develop melodic content focusing on phrase chops, complementing vocal chops and atmosphere.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement structure ensuring smooth cinematic rise and fall with experimental texture diversity.

presetor.brief: Select and apply effects presets enhancing chopping techniques and dark mood.

songgps.brief: Map out section transitions and event markers highlighting energy shifts and chopping technique uses.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Balance mix emphasizing clarity of chopped sample layers preserving cinematic dynamics.
